newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Energy sees Q3 charges.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Energy sees Q3 charges.

text.p: Advanced Energy Industries Inc said it expects to take a third quarter one-time charge of about $3.1 million from the acquisition of Tower Electronics Inc, which was completed as planned August 15.
The company said this write-off is in connection with in-process research and development.

Advanced Energy said it will also take a third quarter charge of about $2.5 million to $3 million due to water damage incurred during a severe rainstorm on July 29 at its headquarters in Fort Collins, Colo.
The company said it suffered water damage to its physical facilities and certain equipment and inventory which interrupted production and shipments.
It said the final charge, which cannot presently be determined, could be larger. The extent of insurance coverage, if any, is unresolved, Advanced Energy said.
The water damage Advanced Energy experienced in July caused some inventory loss.

The Company said it anticipates that because of the lead time required to replace certain damaged components and the lost production time, revenue will be somewhat below that which would have occurred absent the natural disaster, according to chief executive Douglas Schatz

"While revenues will exceed those of the second quarter, they will be somewhat below the Company's goals," he said. "The problem of inventory shortages has been compounded by delays in shipments related to the UPS strike."
